LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.Enabled.Tip: Master switch. While off, no storage routing happens, gizmos are hidden and smelter junk bills find no ingredients; all marks and dump flags are kept and reapplied when re-enabled.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.DebugLevel.Tip: Cycles Off / Basic / Verbose.\n\nBasic logs marks, dump flags and routing recomputes. Verbose additionally logs every storage acceptance override (very spammy - only for hunting a specific issue).
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.RequireJunkStorage.Tip: On: junk-marked items are kept out of normal storage only while at least one junk dump exists on their map - otherwise they flow normally.\n\nOff: junk-marked items are always kept out of normal storage, even with no dump anywhere (they then simply stay where they are).
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.SmelterRecipes.Tip: Adds "smelt/destroy junk" and "destroy junk" bills to electric smelters. They accept only items marked as junk: smeltable things return part of their resources, everything else is simply destroyed. Existing bills are unaffected when turned off.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.LogOverview.Tip: Writes one block per loaded map to the log: every junk dump and the count of junk-marked items.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.BehaviorNote: Mark items with the junk toggle on the item (next to allow/forbidden). Select a stockpile zone or storage building and toggle "Junk dump" to also accept marked items there; toggle "Mark contents as junk" to auto-mark everything stored in it. A dump keeps storing its whitelisted items as usual; normal storage rejects junk while a dump exists. Smelters offer bills to smelt or destroy marked junk.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.MarkJunk.DescOff: Mark this item as junk. Haulers will keep it out of normal storage and carry it to a storage flagged as a junk dump.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.MarkJunk.DescOn: Marked as junk. Haulers carry this to a junk dump and keep it out of normal storage. Unmark to return it to normal storage.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.JunkStorage.DescOff: Flag this storage as a junk dump. It keeps working as normal storage for everything its filter allows, and additionally accepts items marked as junk - which every other storage on this map will then reject (the filter applies to junk too).
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.JunkStorage.DescOn: Flagged as a junk dump: keeps storing everything its filter allows, and additionally accepts items marked as junk that other storage rejects.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.Junkify.DescOff: Automatically mark every item stored here as junk, so haulers carry it on to a junk dump (this stockpile rejects marked items like any other normal storage). Items already stored are marked immediately; the marks are permanent until items are unmarked individually.
LanguageData.MarkAsJunk.Junkify.DescOn: Every item stored here is automatically marked as junk. The marks stay on items even after they leave or this is switched off - unmark items individually to keep them out of the junk flow.
